// File: plan.md (markdown)
# BharatContract AI — Living Plan & Execution Checklist

> Status: ✅ **Phases 1–6 complete + hardening pass.**
> Last update: 2026-10-22

This document is the **single source of truth**. Items prefixed `[ ]` are pending,
`[x]` are completed, `[~]` are partially done.

---

## 0. Project Identity
- **Name:** BharatContract AI (Legal Contract Intelligence)
- **Focus:** Indian Corporate, Commercial, M&A contracts + global cross-border.
- **Stack:** FastAPI · Streamlit · Neo4j · PostgreSQL · Redis · DeBERTa · spaCy.

---

## 1. Phase 1 — Foundation
- [x] Create folder layout (`app/`, `streamlit_app/`, `nlp/`, `data/`, `docker/`, `tests/`...).
- [x] Author `requirements.txt` with pinned versions.
- [x] Author `pyproject.toml` (uv-managed) with optional `[ml]` extra (torch/transformers).
- [x] Author `docker-compose.yml` (Neo4j, Postgres, Redis, API, Streamlit).
- [x] Author `docker/Dockerfile`.
- [x] Author `.env.example`, `.env`, `.gitignore`, `uv.toml`.
- [x] Centralised configuration loader (`app/core/config.py`) using `pydantic-settings`.
- [x] Logger setup (`app/core/logging.py`) using `loguru`.
- [x] Domain exceptions (`app/core/exceptions.py`).
- [x] Document parser (`app/services/parser.py`) supporting PDF, DOCX, TXT with OCR fallback.
- [x] Clause segmenter (`app/services/segmenter.py`) — regex + heading detection + long-clause split.
- [x] Text cleaning utilities (`app/utils/text.py`) with paragraph-preserving whitespace normalisation.
- [x] Filesystem helpers (`app/utils/fs.py`).
- [x] Unit tests for parser + segmenter (`tests/test_parser.py`, `tests/test_segmenter.py`).

---

## 2. Phase 2 — NLP Core
- [x] Clause classifier with DeBERTa-v3 wrapper (`nlp/clause_classification/classifier_ml.py`) — lazy-loaded, optional.
- [x] Rule-based multi-label clause classifier (`nlp/clause_classification/classifier.py`) — primary engine for MVP.
- [x] NER module (`nlp/ner/ner.py`) with regex-first extraction of CIN, PAN, GSTIN, TAN, INR amounts, dates, notice periods, Indian & foreign arbitration seats.
- [x] DeBERTa NER enrichment wrapper (`nlp/ner/ner_ml.py`) — graceful no-op when torch/transformers unavailable.
- [x] spaCy-style obligation extractor (`nlp/obligation_extraction/extractor.py`) — modal-based pattern matching with risk-level derivation.
- [x] Pipeline orchestrator (`app/services/analyzer.py`) tying parser → segmenter → classification → NER → obligations → risk → scoring.

---

## 3. Phase 3 — Risk & Graph
- [x] Indian-statutory risk rules (`nlp/risk_scoring/rules.py`) covering Stamp Duty, Arbitration Seat/Venue mismatch, TDS, Section 124 indemnity, Governing Law mismatch, foreign arbitration seat in domestic contract.
- [x] Global risk rules — uncapped liability, auto-renewal, broad indemnity, one-sided termination, missing clauses, missing data protection.
- [x] Risk scoring aggregator (`nlp/risk_scoring/scorer.py`) with weighted contract score.
- [x] Neo4j connection manager (`app/db/neo4j.py`) with retry-throttling + fast-fail on unavailability + ServiceUnavailable handling.
- [x] Graph write pipeline (`app/db/queries.py`) with idempotent `MERGE` operations and transaction safety.
- [x] Cypher queries — Contract/Clause/Obligation/Risk/Party indexes + contract subgraph fetch.
- [x] PostgreSQL metadata store (`app/db/postgres.py`) with availability cache (no blocking when DB is down).

---

## 4. Phase 4 — Backend & UI
- [x] FastAPI app (`app/main.py`) with lifespan + CORS + exception handlers.
- [x] Pydantic schemas (`app/models/schemas.py`).
- [x] Routes (`app/api/routes_contracts.py`, `routes_jobs.py`, `routes_graph.py`).
- [x] Background job manager (`app/services/jobs.py`) using thread workers + in-memory + DB state.
- [x] Streamlit `Home.py` (upload page) with local-fallback analyser when API is unreachable.
- [x] Streamlit `pages/1_Summary.py` — executive summary with risk badges.
- [x] Streamlit `pages/2_Clause_Explorer.py` — filterable clause list with risk reasons + entity chips.
- [x] Streamlit `pages/3_Obligations.py` — table with CSV export.
- [x] Streamlit `pages/4_Graph.py` — `streamlit-agraph` visualisation with in-memory fallback when Neo4j is unavailable.
- [x] Streamlit `pages/5_Risk_Review.py` — risk review with download.
- [x] `streamlit_app/components/risk_card.py` — risk badge + clause card + header components.

---

## 5. Phase 5 — Tests & Hardening
- [x] End-to-end smoke test (`tests/test_e2e.py`) on bundled sample MSA.
- [x] Unit tests for parser + segmenter.
- [x] Long-clause splitter tests (`tests/test_long_clauses.py`).
- [x] Hybrid classifier accuracy tests on real CUAD data (`tests/test_classifier_accuracy.py`).
- [x] API smoke test via FastAPI `TestClient` (upload → job poll → summary fetch → graph fetch; live server not verified).
- [x] Streamlit `AppTest` smoke check; live HTTP/browser boot not verified.
- [x] README with run instructions.
- [x] Sample contract fixture (`data/raw/sample_msa.txt`).
- [x] Demo script (`scripts/run_demo.py`).

---

## 6. Phase 6 — Real Legal Datasets (Aug 2026)
- [x] Download **CUAD** (Contract Understanding Atticus Dataset, NeurIPS 2021)
      → `data/datasets/cuad/CUADv1.json`, `train_separate_questions.json`, `test.json`, `category_descriptions.csv`.
- [x] Download **MAUD** (Merger Agreement Understanding Dataset, Atticus Project)
      → `data/datasets/maud/data/{MAUD_train,dev,test}.csv` + 152 contract files.
- [x] `nlp/datasets/unified.py` — common `TrainingExample` schema + CUAD/MAUD label mappers.
- [x] `nlp/datasets/cuad.py` — SQuAD-format reader → clause snippets + gold spans.
- [x] `nlp/datasets/maud.py` — CSV reader → clause-type examples.
- [x] `scripts/build_training_data.py` — orchestrator that materialises
      `cuad_examples.jsonl`, `maud_examples.jsonl`, `unified_examples.jsonl`,
      `clause_classifier.csv`, and `cuad_keyword_bank.json`.
- [x] **66,514** unified training rows covering 15 populated internal categories
      (11,508 positive clause-classifier rows after filtering/deduplication).
- [x] `nlp/clause_classification/classifier.py`:
      - Auto-loads CUAD keyword bank on import (top 80 keywords/category).
      - Hybrid pipeline: TF-IDF + Logistic Regression ML model + rule-based fallback.
      - Tests enforce top-1 ≥30% and top-3 ≥55% on a fixed CUAD sample; these are regression floors, not an independent benchmark.
- [x] `scripts/train_tfidf_classifier.py` — sklearn pipeline trainer that
      persists to `models/tfidf_classifier.joblib`.
- [x] `scripts/eval_classifier.py` — per-category top-1 accuracy report.

---

## 7. Hardening Pass (2026-10-22)
- [x] Single taxonomy source (`nlp/taxonomy.py`); CUAD/MAUD loaders emit canonical labels.
- [x] MAUD loader rewritten for the real CSV schema; CUAD retains negative examples for the keyword bank.
- [x] Bundled model loader (`nlp/clause_classification/tfidf_model.py`) extracts the 7z archive with `py7zr`, maps legacy `Pricing Terms` to `Payment Terms`, drops non-canonical labels, and suppresses sklearn version warnings.
- [x] Keyword classifier uses letter-boundary matching; evaluation precision fixed.
- [x] NER: valid CIN/LLPIN/GSTIN regexes, raw-text offsets, seat/venue/law detection.
- [x] Obligations: prohibition/right/obligation precedence, first-modal subject, hours-aware deadlines, descriptive `seat/venue/governed` sentences ignored.
- [x] Risk playbook: contract-level Indian rules execute, auto-renewal context, breach hours, liability-cap guard, arbitration mismatch guards.
- [x] Backend: JSON-safe job persistence, DB fallbacks, bounded in-memory jobs, upload size pre-check, Neo4j lazy availability, unique graph IDs, strict CORS defaults.
- [x] Docker: correct build context, project install, `.dockerignore`, healthchecks, ordered startup, renderer/UI fixes.
- [x] Regression tests for obligation subjects and job serialisation; full pytest + ruff pass.

---

## 8. Architectural Notes (auto-populated)
- 2026-08-18: Chose `pdfplumber` (primary) + `PyMuPDF` (fallback) + `pytesseract` (OCR fallback triggered when < 50 chars on a page).
- 2026-08-18: Chose `microsoft/deberta-v3-base` for both classification and NER — wrapped behind lazy import so the stack runs without ML deps. Regex fallback covers CIN/PAN/GSTIN/dates.
- 2026-08-18: Risk engine is rule-first; ML risk classifier deferred to post-MVP.
- 2026-08-18: Neo4j used in single-instance mode for MVP. Connection attempts are throttled to once every 10s when failing — keeps pipeline responsive without retry storms.
- 2026-08-18: Postgres connection is probed once at engine init; subsequent calls fast-fail via `_AVAILABLE_CACHE` so job runtime stays < 1s when DB is down.
- 2026-08-18: Party detection uses NER + suffix-based regex fallback with noise-word stripping (handles "between X and Y" preamble pattern common in MSA preambles).
- 2026-08-18: Streamlit graph page has in-memory fallback that reconstructs the graph from the AnalysisResult when Neo4j is unavailable — so the demo works without external infra.

---

## 8. Deferred / Post-MVP
- OCR with `surya-ocr` or `docTR` (pytesseract is enough for MVP).
- Hindi / regional language support (Indic-BERT / MuRIL).
- LLM-based redline generation (Llama-3 / Qwen).
- Case-law link augmentation.
- Workflow approval / Slack / Jira integrations.
- ML-driven risk classifier (today is rule-only).
- Per-user authentication & row-level security in Postgres.

// File: pyproject.toml (toml)
[project]
name = "bharatcontract-ai"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Legal Contract Intelligence — Indian-context risk-aware clause extraction & obligation tracker"
authors = [{ name = "BharatContract AI Team" }]
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10,<3.13"

dependencies = [
    # NLP rules (light)
    "spacy>=3.7,<4",
    # Backend
    "fastapi>=0.110,<1",
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.27,<1",
    "pydantic>=2.6,<3",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.1,<3",
    "python-multipart>=0.0.9,<1",
    "python-jose[cryptography]>=3.3,<4",
    "passlib[bcrypt]>=1.7,<2",
    # Task queue / cache
    "celery>=5.3,<6",
    "redis>=5.0,<6",
    # Databases
    "neo4j>=5.18,<6",
    "SQLAlchemy>=2.0,<3",
    "psycopg2-binary>=2.9,<3",
    "alembic>=1.13,<2",
    # Frontend / dashboards
    "streamlit>=1.31,<2",
    "streamlit-agraph>=0.0.45",
    "pyvis>=0.3.2",
    "plotly>=5.18,<6",
    "pandas>=2.0,<3",
    "numpy>=1.26,<2",
    # Document parsing
    "pdfplumber>=0.10,<1",
    "PyMuPDF>=1.23,<2",
    "python-docx>=1.0,<2",
    "pytesseract>=0.3.10",
    "Pillow>=10.0,<12",
    # Utilities
    "httpx>=0.27,<1",
    "requests>=2.31,<3",
    "tenacity>=8.2,<9",
    "python-dateutil>=2.8,<3",
    "PyPDF2>=3.0,<4",
    "python-dotenv>=1.0,<2",
    "loguru>=0.7,<1",
    "scikit-learn>=1.3,<2",
    "py7zr>=1.1.4",
    "joblib>=1.5.3",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
ml = [
    "transformers>=4.36,<5",
    "torch>=2.1,<3",
    "tokenizers>=0.15,<1",
    "accelerate>=0.25,<1",
    "sentence-transformers>=2.2,<3",
    "unstructured>=0.11,<1",
    "scikit-learn>=1.3,<2",
]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0,<9",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.23,<1",
    "pytest-cov>=4.1,<5",
    "ruff>=0.3,<1",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0,<9",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.23,<1",
    "pytest-cov>=4.1,<5",
    "ruff>=0.3,<1",
    "scikit-learn>=1.3,<2",
]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
addopts = "-ra -q"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 110
target-version = "py310"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "W", "B"]
ignore = ["E501"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"app/api/*.py" = ["B008"]  # FastAPI dependency markers are function calls by design

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["app", "nlp", "streamlit_app"]

// File: app/api/routes_contracts.py (python)
"""Contract upload + analysis routes."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, File, Form, HTTPException, UploadFile
from starlette.concurrency import run_in_threadpool

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.exceptions import DocumentParseError, UnsupportedFormatError
from app.core.logging import get_logger
from app.db.postgres import upsert_contract_metadata
from app.db.queries import write_analysis
from app.models.schemas import (
    AnalysisResult,
    ContractType,
    JobInfo,
    PartySide,
)
from app.services.analyzer import analyse_bytes
from app.services.jobs import create_job, run_in_background

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/contracts", tags=["contracts"])
logger = get_logger()


_ALLOWED_EXT = {".pdf", ".docx", ".txt", ".md"}


def _ext_of(name: str) -> str:
    return "." + name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() if "." in name else ""


@router.post("/upload", response_model=JobInfo)
async def upload_contract(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    contract_type: ContractType = Form(ContractType.OTHER),
    user_role: PartySide = Form(PartySide.CUSTOMER.value),
    jurisdiction: str = Form("India"),
    playbook_id: Optional[str] = Form(None),
):
    """Upload a contract and kick off background analysis."""
    settings = get_settings()
    filename = file.filename or "upload"
    ext = _ext_of(filename)
    if ext not in _ALLOWED_EXT:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Unsupported file type: {ext}")

    max_bytes = settings.max_upload_mb * 1024 * 1024
    if getattr(file, "size", None) is not None and file.size > max_bytes:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=413,
            detail=f"File exceeds the {settings.max_upload_mb} MB limit.",
        )
    contents = await file.read(max_bytes + 1)
    if len(contents) > max_bytes:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=413,
            detail=f"File exceeds the {settings.max_upload_mb} MB limit.",
        )

    contract_id = _contract_id_for(filename, contents)
    job = await run_in_threadpool(create_job, contract_id)

    def worker(info: JobInfo) -> AnalysisResult:
        def update_progress(p: float, msg: str) -> None:
            _update(info.job_id, progress=p, message=msg)
        update_progress(0.1, "Parsing document")
        try:
            result = analyse_bytes(
                contents,
                filename,
                contract_id=contract_id,
                contract_type=contract_type,
                user_role=user_role,
                jurisdiction=jurisdiction,
                enable_ocr=settings.enable_ocr_fallback,
            )
        except (DocumentParseError, UnsupportedFormatError) as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(str(exc)) from exc
        update_progress(0.7, "Persisting to graph")
        write_analysis(result)
        update_progress(0.85, "Saving metadata")
        upsert_contract_metadata(
            {
                "contract_id": contract_id,
                "title": result.contract.title,
                "file_name": result.contract.file_name,
                "contract_type": result.contract.contract_type.value,
                "status": "succeeded",
                "overall_risk_score": result.contract.overall_risk_score,
                "overall_risk_level": result.contract.overall_risk_level.value,
                "payload": {"warnings": result.warnings, "obligation_count": len(result.obligations)},
            }
        )
        update_progress(1.0, "Done")
        return result

    run_in_background(worker, job.job_id, contract_id)
    return job


@router.get("/{contract_id}/summary")
def contract_summary(contract_id: str):
    job = _latest_job_for(contract_id)
    if not job or not job.result:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Contract not found or still processing")
    return job.result.contract


@router.get("/{contract_id}/clauses")
def contract_clauses(contract_id: str):
    job = _latest_job_for(contract_id)
    if not job or not job.result:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Contract not found")
    return {"clauses": job.result.clauses}


@router.get("/{contract_id}/obligations")
def contract_obligations(contract_id: str):
    job = _latest_job_for(contract_id)
    if not job or not job.result:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Contract not found")
    return {"obligations": job.result.obligations}


@router.get("/{contract_id}/risks")
def contract_risks(contract_id: str):
    job = _latest_job_for(contract_id)
    if not job or not job.result:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Contract not found")
    return {"risks": job.result.risks}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _update(job_id: str, *, progress: float, message: str) -> None:
    from app.services.jobs import update_job

    update_job(job_id, progress=progress, message=message)


def _contract_id_for(filename: str, contents: bytes) -> str:
    import hashlib

    digest = hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest()[:10]
    stamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    return f"c_{stamp}_{digest}"


def _latest_job_for(contract_id: str) -> Optional[JobInfo]:
    from app.services.jobs import list_jobs

    candidates = [j for j in list_jobs() if j.contract_id == contract_id]
    if not candidates:
        return None
    candidates.sort(key=lambda j: j.created_at, reverse=True)
    return candidates[0]


// File: app/api/routes_graph.py (python)
"""Graph routes."""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

from app.db.queries import fetch_graph
from app.services.jobs import list_jobs

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/graph", tags=["graph"])


@router.get("/{contract_id}")
def get_graph(contract_id: str):
    """Return the subgraph for a contract. Falls back to in-memory job results
    if Neo4j is unavailable so the UI can still render in the demo.
    """
    snapshot = fetch_graph(contract_id)
    if snapshot.nodes:
        return snapshot
    # In-memory fallback
    for j in list_jobs():
        if j.contract_id == contract_id and j.result:
            return _graph_from_result(contract_id, j.result)
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Graph not available")


def _graph_from_result(contract_id: str, result) -> dict:
    """Build a simple in-memory graph when Neo4j is down."""
    nodes: list[dict] = []
    edges: list[dict] = []
    nodes.append(
        {
            "id": contract_id,
            "label": "Contract",
            "properties": {
                "title": result.contract.title,
                "risk_score": result.contract.overall_risk_score,
                "risk_level": result.contract.overall_risk_level.value,
            },
        }
    )
    for cl in result.clauses:
        nodes.append(
            {
                "id": cl.clause_id,
                "label": "Clause",
                "properties": {
                    "heading": cl.heading,
                    "clause_types": cl.clause_types,
                    "risk_score": cl.risk_score,
                    "risk_level": cl.risk_level.value,
                },
            }
        )
        edges.append({"source": contract_id, "target": cl.clause_id, "type": "HAS_CLAUSE"})
    for ob in result.obligations:
        nodes.append(
            {
                "id": ob.obligation_id,
                "label": "Obligation",
                "properties": {
                    "type": ob.obligation_type.value,
                    "action": ob.action,
                    "deadline": ob.deadline_expression,
                },
            }
        )
        edges.append({"source": ob.clause_id, "target": ob.obligation_id, "type": "IMPOSES"})
    for rk in result.risks:
        nodes.append(
            {
                "id": rk.risk_id,
                "label": "Risk",
                "properties": {"name": rk.name, "severity": rk.severity.value},
            }
        )
        if rk.clause_id:
            edges.append({"source": rk.clause_id, "target": rk.risk_id, "type": "TRIGGERS"})
    return {"contract_id": contract_id, "nodes": nodes, "edges": edges}

"""Job status routes."""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

from app.services.jobs import get_job, list_jobs

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/jobs", tags=["jobs"])


@router.get("/{job_id}")
def job_status(job_id: str):
    job = get_job(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found")
    return job


@router.get("")
def list_all_jobs():
    return {"jobs": list_jobs()}


// File: app/core/config.py (python)
"""Centralised configuration loader for BharatContract AI.

Loads values from environment variables and the optional `.env` file.
Uses pydantic-settings for type-validated config objects so downstream
modules can rely on attribute access rather than `os.getenv`.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List

from pydantic import Field
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    """Top-level settings object.

    All values are environment-overridable. Defaults are development-friendly.
    """

    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_file=str(PROJECT_ROOT / ".env"),
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        extra="ignore",
        case_sensitive=False,
    )

    # App
    app_name: str = Field(default="BharatContract AI")
    app_env: str = Field(default="development")

    # PostgreSQL
    database_url: str = Field(default="postgresql://bharat:contractpass@localhost:5432/bharatcontract")

    # Redis
    redis_url: str = Field(default="redis://localhost:6379/0")

    # Neo4j
    neo4j_uri: str = Field(default="bolt://localhost:7687")
    neo4j_user: str = Field(default="neo4j")
    neo4j_password: str = Field(default="contractpass")

    # API
    api_host: str = Field(default="0.0.0.0")
    api_port: int = Field(default=8000)
    api_base_url: str = Field(default="http://localhost:8000")

    # Streamlit
    streamlit_port: int = Field(default=8501)

    # Models
    model_cache_dir: str = Field(default=str(PROJECT_ROOT / "models"))
    hf_home: str = Field(default=str(PROJECT_ROOT / "models" / "hf"))
    clause_model: str = Field(default="microsoft/deberta-v3-base")
    ner_model: str = Field(default="microsoft/deberta-v3-base")
    spacy_model: str = Field(default="en_core_web_sm")

    # Uploads
    upload_dir: str = Field(default=str(PROJECT_ROOT / "uploads"))
    max_upload_mb: int = Field(default=25)

    # Logging
    log_level: str = Field(default="INFO")
    log_file: str = Field(default=str(PROJECT_ROOT / "logs" / "bharatcontract.log"))

    # Indian context
    default_jurisdiction: str = Field(default="India")

    # CORS
    cors_origins: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: ["http://localhost:8501", "http://127.0.0.1:8501"]
    )

    # Internal toggles
    enable_background_jobs: bool = Field(default=True)
    enable_ocr_fallback: bool = Field(default=True)

    # NLP toggles (used in MVP to gracefully fall back when models missing)
    use_rule_based_classifier: bool = Field(default=True)

    def ensure_dirs(self) -> None:
        """Create required directories on disk if missing."""
        for path in (self.upload_dir, self.model_cache_dir, self.hf_home,
                     Path(self.log_file).parent):
            Path(path).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    """Return the cached Settings singleton."""
    s = Settings()
    s.ensure_dirs()
    os.environ.setdefault("HF_HOME", s.hf_home)
    return s

"""FastAPI entrypoint for BharatContract AI."""
from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.api import routes_contracts, routes_graph, routes_jobs
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.exceptions import BharatContractError
from app.core.logging import get_logger, setup_logging
from app.db.neo4j import Neo4jConnection, ensure_indexes

setup_logging()
logger = get_logger()


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    settings = get_settings()
    logger.info("Starting {} (env={})", settings.app_name, settings.app_env)
    # Touch Neo4j once so failures show in startup logs.
    conn = Neo4jConnection.instance()
    _ = conn.available
    if conn.available:
        ensure_indexes()
    yield
    conn.close()
    logger.info("Shutdown complete")


app = FastAPI(
    title="BharatContract AI API",
    description="Legal Contract Intelligence — Indian-context risk-aware clause extraction & obligation tracker.",
    version="0.1.0",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Middleware
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

settings = get_settings()
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=settings.cors_origins,
    allow_credentials="*" not in settings.cors_origins,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


@app.exception_handler(BharatContractError)
async def _bharatcontract_error_handler(request: Request, exc: BharatContractError):
    logger.warning("Domain error on {}: {}", request.url.path, exc)
    return JSONResponse(status_code=exc.status_code, content={"detail": str(exc)})


@app.exception_handler(Exception)
async def _unhandled_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception):
    logger.exception("Unhandled error on {}", request.url.path)
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=500,
        content={"detail": "Internal server error", "type": type(exc).__name__},
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Routes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

app.include_router(routes_contracts.router)
app.include_router(routes_jobs.router)
app.include_router(routes_graph.router)


@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {
        "name": "BharatContract AI",
        "version": "0.1.0",
        "docs": "/docs",
        "health": "/healthz",
    }


@app.get("/healthz")
def healthz():
    settings = get_settings()
    neo4j_ok = Neo4jConnection.instance().available
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "neo4j": neo4j_ok,
        "env": settings.app_env,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: no cover
    import uvicorn

    uvicorn.run(
        "app.main:app",
        host=settings.api_host,
        port=settings.api_port,
        reload=False,
    )

// File: app/core/exceptions.py (python)
"""Custom exception types for the BharatContract AI stack."""
from __future__ import annotations


class BharatContractError(Exception):
    """Base exception for all domain errors."""

    status_code: int = 500

    def __init__(self, message: str, *, status_code: int | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        if status_code is not None:
            self.status_code = status_code


class DocumentParseError(BharatContractError):
    """Raised when a contract cannot be parsed or extracted."""

    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message, status_code=400)


class UnsupportedFormatError(DocumentParseError):
    """Raised when the uploaded file type is not supported."""

    def __init__(self, ext: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"Unsupported file format: {ext}")


class ModelNotAvailableError(BharatContractError):
    """Raised when an NLP model is requested but cannot be loaded."""

    def __init__(self, model_name: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"NLP model not available: {model_name}", status_code=503)


class GraphWriteError(BharatContractError):
    """Raised when Neo4j writes fail and rollback did not resolve the issue."""

    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message, status_code=500)

"""Logging setup using loguru with safe fallbacks."""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from loguru import logger

from app.core.config import get_settings

_configured = False


def setup_logging(level: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
    """Configure loguru sinks (stderr + rotating file). Idempotent."""
    global _configured
    if _configured:
        return

    settings = get_settings()
    log_level = (level or settings.log_level).upper()
    log_file = Path(settings.log_file)
    log_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    logger.remove()
    logger.add(
        sys.stderr,
        level=log_level,
        format=(
            "<green>{time:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss}</green> | "
            "<level>{level: <8}</level> | "
            "<cyan>{name}:{function}:{line}</cyan> - <level>{message}</level>"
        ),
        enqueue=False,
        backtrace=False,
        diagnose=False,
    )
    logger.add(
        str(log_file),
        level=log_level,
        rotation="10 MB",
        retention="10 days",
        enqueue=True,
        backtrace=True,
        diagnose=False,
    )

    _configured = True
    logger.info("Logging initialised at level {}", log_level)


def get_logger():
    """Return the configured logger instance."""
    if not _configured:
        setup_logging()
    return logger

"""Database adapters: Neo4j (graph) and PostgreSQL (metadata)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from contextlib import contextmanager
from typing import List, Optional

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.exceptions import GraphWriteError
from app.core.logging import get_logger

logger = get_logger()
_stdlib_logger = logging.getLogger("neo4j")
_stdlib_logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)


class Neo4jConnection:
    """Lazy, retry-aware Neo4j driver wrapper."""

    _instance: Optional["Neo4jConnection"] = None

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._driver = None
        self._available = False
        self._connect_attempts = 0
        self._last_connect_attempt: float = 0.0

    @classmethod
    def instance(cls) -> "Neo4jConnection":
        if cls._instance is None:
            cls._instance = cls()
        return cls._instance

    @property
    def driver(self):
        if self._driver is None:
            self._connect()
        return self._driver

    def _connect(self) -> None:
        import time as _time

        from neo4j import GraphDatabase
        from neo4j.exceptions import ServiceUnavailable

        # Throttle connection attempts to once per 10 seconds when failing.
        now = _time.time()
        if self._connect_attempts >= 1 and (now - self._last_connect_attempt) < 10:
            return
        self._last_connect_attempt = now
        self._connect_attempts += 1

        s = get_settings()
        try:
            self._driver = GraphDatabase.driver(
                s.neo4j_uri,
                auth=(s.neo4j_user, s.neo4j_password),
                max_connection_lifetime=3600,
                connection_acquisition_timeout=3,
                encrypted=False,
            )
            with self._driver.session() as session:
                session.run("RETURN 1").consume()
            self._available = True
            self._connect_attempts = 0
            logger.info("Connected to Neo4j at {}", s.neo4j_uri)
        except (ServiceUnavailable, Exception) as exc:
            self._available = False
            logger.warning("Neo4j unavailable: {}", exc)
            self._driver = None

    @property
    def available(self) -> bool:
        if self._driver is None:
            self._connect()
        return self._available

    def close(self) -> None:
        if self._driver is not None:
            try:
                self._driver.close()
            except Exception:  # pragma: no cover
                pass
        self._driver = None
        self._available = False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Index bootstrap
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


INDEX_QUERIES = [
    "CREATE INDEX contract_id_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Contract) ON (n.contract_id)",
    "CREATE INDEX clause_id_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Clause) ON (n.clause_id)",
    "CREATE INDEX company_cin_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Company) ON (n.cin)",
    "CREATE INDEX obligation_id_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Obligation) ON (n.obligation_id)",
    "CREATE INDEX party_name_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Party) ON (n.name)",
    "CREATE CONSTRAINT contract_id_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Contract) REQUIRE n.contract_id IS UNIQUE",
]


def ensure_indexes() -> bool:
    """Create Neo4j indexes. Returns True if successful."""
    conn = Neo4jConnection.instance()
    if not conn.available:
        return False
    try:
        with conn.driver.session() as session:
            for q in INDEX_QUERIES:
                session.run(q).consume()
        logger.info("Neo4j indexes ensured")
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("Failed to create Neo4j indexes: {}", exc)
        return False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Context manager helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@contextmanager
def neo4j_session():
    conn = Neo4jConnection.instance()
    if not conn.available:
        raise GraphWriteError("Neo4j is not available")
    session = conn.driver.session()
    try:
        yield session
    finally:
        session.close()


def run_write(query: str, parameters: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Execute a write query with retry. Fast-fails if Neo4j is unreachable."""
    from neo4j.exceptions import ServiceUnavailable, TransientError

    conn = Neo4jConnection.instance()
    if not conn.available:
        raise GraphWriteError("Neo4j is not available")
    try:
        driver = conn.driver
        last_exc: Exception | None = None
        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                with driver.session() as session:
                    return session.execute_write(
                        lambda tx: tx.run(query, parameters or {}).consume()
                    )
            except TransientError as exc:
                last_exc = exc
                import time as _time
                _time.sleep(0.5 * (attempt + 1))
                continue
            except ServiceUnavailable as exc:
                # Driver knows Neo4j is gone — abort immediately.
                conn._available = False
                raise GraphWriteError(str(exc)) from exc
        raise GraphWriteError(str(last_exc) if last_exc else "Transient write error")
    except GraphWriteError:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        raise GraphWriteError(str(exc)) from exc


def run_read(query: str, parameters: dict | None = None) -> List[dict]:
    """Execute a read query and return list of dicts."""
    conn = Neo4jConnection.instance()
    if not conn.available:
        return []
    try:
        with conn.driver.session() as session:
            result = session.run(query, parameters or {})
            return [dict(record) for record in result]
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("Neo4j read failed: {}", exc)
        return []

"""PostgreSQL session setup for metadata storage.

The MVP keeps things simple — a single SQLAlchemy engine, metadata tables
created on first request. Heavy use of Neo4j is preferred for relationships.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Iterator, Optional

from sqlalchemy import (
    JSON,
    Column,
    DateTime,
    Float,
    String,
    Text,
    create_engine,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.logging import get_logger

logger = get_logger()


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class ContractRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "contracts"

    contract_id = Column(String, primary_key=True)
    title = Column(String, default="")
    file_name = Column(String, default="")
    contract_type = Column(String, default="OTHER")
    status = Column(String, default="processing")
    overall_risk_score = Column(Float, default=0.0)
    overall_risk_level = Column(String, default="low")
    payload = Column(JSON, default=dict)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)


class JobRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "jobs"

    job_id = Column(String, primary_key=True)
    contract_id = Column(String, index=True)
    status = Column(String, default="queued")
    progress = Column(Float, default=0.0)
    message = Column(Text, default="")
    result = Column(JSON, default=dict)
    error = Column(Text, default="")
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    finished_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)


_engine: Optional[object] = None
_SessionLocal: Optional[sessionmaker] = None


def get_engine():
    global _engine
    if _engine is None:
        settings = get_settings()
        try:
            _engine = create_engine(
                settings.database_url,
                pool_pre_ping=False,
                pool_size=5,
                max_overflow=5,
                future=True,
                connect_args={"connect_timeout": 3},
            )
            # Probe connection with a short timeout; do not block on cold start.
            with _engine.connect() as conn:
                conn.execute(__import__("sqlalchemy").text("SELECT 1"))
            Base.metadata.create_all(_engine)
            logger.info("Postgres engine initialised at {}", settings.database_url)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("Postgres unavailable ({}). Metadata writes will be no-ops.", exc)
            _engine = None
            set_postgres_unavailable()
    return _engine


def get_sessionmaker() -> Optional[sessionmaker]:
    global _SessionLocal
    engine = get_engine()
    if engine is None:
        return None
    if _SessionLocal is None:
        _SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False, future=True)
    return _SessionLocal


@contextmanager
def session_scope() -> Iterator[Optional[Session]]:
    sm = get_sessionmaker()
    if sm is None:
        yield None
        return
    session = sm()
    try:
        yield session
        session.commit()
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        session.close()


_AVAILABLE_CACHE: dict[str, bool] = {"postgres": True}


def postgres_available() -> bool:
    """Cheap check; if engine init failed once, skip for the rest of this process."""
    return _AVAILABLE_CACHE.get("postgres", False)


def set_postgres_unavailable() -> None:
    _AVAILABLE_CACHE["postgres"] = False


def upsert_contract_metadata(record: dict) -> bool:
    if not postgres_available():
        return False
    try:
        with session_scope() as session:
            if session is None:
                return False
            obj = session.get(ContractRecord, record["contract_id"])
            if obj is None:
                obj = ContractRecord(contract_id=record["contract_id"])
                session.add(obj)
            for key in (
                "title",
                "file_name",
                "contract_type",
                "status",
                "overall_risk_score",
                "overall_risk_level",
                "payload",
            ):
                if key in record:
                    setattr(obj, key, record[key])
            return True
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("Contract metadata write failed: {}", exc)
        return False


def upsert_job(record: dict) -> bool:
    if not postgres_available():
        return False
    try:
        with session_scope() as session:
            if session is None:
                return False
            obj = session.get(JobRecord, record["job_id"])
            if obj is None:
                obj = JobRecord(job_id=record["job_id"])
                session.add(obj)
            for key in (
                "contract_id",
                "status",
                "progress",
                "message",
                "result",
                "error",
            ):
                if key in record:
                    setattr(obj, key, record[key])
            if record.get("status") in {"succeeded", "failed"}:
                obj.finished_at = datetime.utcnow()
            return True
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("Job write failed: {}", exc)
        return False


def get_job(job_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    if not postgres_available():
        return None
    with session_scope() as session:
        if session is None:
            return None
        obj = session.get(JobRecord, job_id)
        if obj is None:
            return None
        return {
            "job_id": obj.job_id,
            "contract_id": obj.contract_id,
            "status": obj.status,
            "progress": obj.progress,
            "message": obj.message,
            "result": obj.result,
            "error": obj.error,
            "created_at": obj.created_at.isoformat() if obj.created_at else None,
            "finished_at": obj.finished_at.isoformat() if obj.finished_at else None,
        }


def list_jobs(limit: int = 200) -> list[dict]:
    if not postgres_available():
        return []
    with session_scope() as session:
        if session is None:
            return []
        rows = (
            session.query(JobRecord)
            .order_by(JobRecord.created_at.desc())
            .limit(limit)
            .all()
        )
        return [{"job_id": r.job_id} for r in rows]


def list_contracts(limit: int = 100) -> list[dict]:
    if not postgres_available():
        return []
    with session_scope() as session:
        if session is None:
            return []
        rows = (
            session.query(ContractRecord)
            .order_by(ContractRecord.created_at.desc())
            .limit(limit)
            .all()
        )
        return [
            {
                "contract_id": r.contract_id,
                "title": r.title,
                "file_name": r.file_name,
                "status": r.status,
                "overall_risk_score": r.overall_risk_score,
                "overall_risk_level": r.overall_risk_level,
                "created_at": r.created_at.isoformat() if r.created_at else None,
            }
            for r in rows
        ]

"""Cypher query library + graph writer."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import List

from app.core.logging import get_logger
from app.db.neo4j import run_read, run_write
from app.models.schemas import (
    AnalysisResult,
    Clause,
    ContractSummary,
    GraphEdge,
    GraphNode,
    GraphSnapshot,
    Obligation,
    RiskFlag,
)

logger = get_logger()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Write helpers (idempotent via MERGE)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def upsert_contract(contract: ContractSummary) -> bool:
    query = """
    MERGE (c:Contract {contract_id: $contract_id})
    SET c.title = $title,
        c.file_name = $file_name,
        c.contract_type = $contract_type,
        c.parties = $parties,
        c.effective_date = $effective_date,
        c.expiry_date = $expiry_date,
        c.governing_law = $governing_law,
        c.arbitration_seat = $arbitration_seat,
        c.stamp_duty_mentioned = $stamp_duty_mentioned,
        c.tds_mentioned = $tds_mentioned,
        c.gstin_mentioned = $gstin_mentioned,
        c.overall_risk_score = $overall_risk_score,
        c.overall_risk_level = $overall_risk_level,
        c.analyzed_at = datetime($analyzed_at)
    RETURN c
    """
    try:
        run_write(
            query,
            {
                "contract_id": contract.contract_id,
                "title": contract.title,
                "file_name": contract.file_name,
                "contract_type": contract.contract_type.value,
                "parties": contract.parties,
                "effective_date": contract.effective_date,
                "expiry_date": contract.expiry_date,
                "governing_law": contract.governing_law,
                "arbitration_seat": contract.arbitration_seat,
                "stamp_duty_mentioned": contract.stamp_duty_mentioned,
                "tds_mentioned": contract.tds_mentioned,
                "gstin_mentioned": contract.gstin_mentioned,
                "overall_risk_score": contract.overall_risk_score,
                "overall_risk_level": contract.overall_risk_level.value,
                "analyzed_at": contract.analyzed_at.isoformat(),
            },
        )
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("upsert_contract failed: {}", exc)
        return False


def upsert_clause(contract_id: str, clause: Clause) -> bool:
    query = """
    MATCH (c:Contract {contract_id: $contract_id})
    MERGE (cl:Clause {clause_id: $clause_id})
    SET cl.contract_id = $contract_id,
        cl.section_number = $section_number,
        cl.heading = $heading,
        cl.text = $text,
        cl.page_hint = $page_hint,
        cl.char_start = $char_start,
        cl.char_end = $char_end,
        cl.clause_types = $clause_types,
        cl.risk_score = $risk_score,
        cl.risk_level = $risk_level
    MERGE (c)-[:HAS_CLAUSE]->(cl)
    RETURN cl
    """
    try:
        run_write(
            query,
            {
                "contract_id": contract_id,
                "clause_id": clause.clause_id,
                "section_number": clause.section_number,
                "heading": clause.heading,
                "text": clause.text,
                "page_hint": clause.page_hint,
                "char_start": clause.char_start,
                "char_end": clause.char_end,
                "clause_types": clause.clause_types,
                "risk_score": clause.risk_score,
                "risk_level": clause.risk_level.value,
            },
        )
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("upsert_clause failed for {}: {}", clause.clause_id, exc)
        return False


def upsert_obligation(contract_id: str, obligation: Obligation) -> bool:
    query = """
    MATCH (cl:Clause {clause_id: $clause_id})
    MERGE (o:Obligation {obligation_id: $obligation_id})
    SET o.contract_id = $contract_id,
        o.text = $text,
        o.obligation_type = $obligation_type,
        o.subject = $subject,
        o.counterparty = $counterparty,
        o.action = $action,
        o.object = $object,
        o.condition = $condition,
        o.deadline_expression = $deadline_expression,
        o.deadline_date = $deadline_date,
        o.risk_level = $risk_level,
        o.confidence = $confidence
    MERGE (cl)-[:IMPOSES]->(o)
    RETURN o
    """
    try:
        run_write(
            query,
            {
                "clause_id": obligation.clause_id,
                "contract_id": contract_id,
                "obligation_id": obligation.obligation_id,
                "text": obligation.text,
                "obligation_type": obligation.obligation_type.value,
                "subject": obligation.subject,
                "counterparty": obligation.counterparty,
                "action": obligation.action,
                "object": obligation.object,
                "condition": obligation.condition,
                "deadline_expression": obligation.deadline_expression,
                "deadline_date": obligation.deadline_date,
                "risk_level": obligation.risk_level.value,
                "confidence": obligation.confidence,
            },
        )
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("upsert_obligation failed: {}", exc)
        return False


def upsert_risk(contract_id: str, risk: RiskFlag) -> bool:
    """Persist a RiskFlag. If risk has a clause_id, link via :TRIGGERS."""
    base_query = """
    MERGE (r:Risk {risk_id: $risk_id})
    SET r.contract_id = $contract_id,
        r.rule_id = $rule_id,
        r.name = $name,
        r.severity = $severity,
        r.explanation = $explanation,
        r.recommendation = $recommendation,
        r.score = $score
    """
    try:
        run_write(
            base_query,
            {
                "risk_id": risk.risk_id,
                "contract_id": contract_id,
                "rule_id": risk.rule_id,
                "name": risk.name,
                "severity": risk.severity.value,
                "explanation": risk.explanation,
                "recommendation": risk.recommendation,
                "score": risk.score,
            },
        )
        if risk.clause_id:
            link_query = """
            MATCH (r:Risk {risk_id: $risk_id}), (cl:Clause {clause_id: $clause_id})
            MERGE (cl)-[:TRIGGERS]->(r)
            """
            run_write(link_query, {"risk_id": risk.risk_id, "clause_id": risk.clause_id})
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("upsert_risk failed: {}", exc)
        return False


def upsert_party(contract_id: str, party_name: str) -> bool:
    query = """
    MATCH (c:Contract {contract_id: $contract_id})
    MERGE (p:Party {name: $name})
    MERGE (c)-[:HAS_PARTY]->(p)
    RETURN p
    """
    try:
        run_write(query, {"contract_id": contract_id, "name": party_name})
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("upsert_party failed: {}", exc)
        return False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def fetch_graph(contract_id: str) -> GraphSnapshot:
    """Return the subgraph for a contract as plain Python dicts."""
    nodes_query = """
    MATCH (n)
    WHERE (n.contract_id = $cid) OR
          (n)-[:HAS_CLAUSE|IMPOSES|TRIGGERS|HAS_PARTY]-({contract_id: $cid})
    RETURN DISTINCT
        coalesce(n.clause_id, n.obligation_id, n.risk_id, n.contract_id, n.name) AS id,
        labels(n)[0] AS label,
        properties(n) AS properties
    """
    edges_query = """
    MATCH (a)-[r]->(b)
    WHERE (a.contract_id = $cid OR b.contract_id = $cid OR
           a.clause_id IN $clause_ids OR b.clause_id IN $clause_ids)
    RETURN DISTINCT
        coalesce(a.clause_id, a.obligation_id, a.risk_id, a.contract_id, a.name) AS source,
        coalesce(b.clause_id, b.obligation_id, b.risk_id, b.contract_id, b.name) AS target,
        type(r) AS type
    """

    raw_nodes = run_read(nodes_query, {"cid": contract_id})
    if not raw_nodes:
        return GraphSnapshot(contract_id=contract_id, nodes=[], edges=[])

    clause_ids = [
        n["properties"].get("clause_id")
        for n in raw_nodes
        if n.get("label") == "Clause" and n["properties"].get("clause_id")
    ]
    raw_edges = run_read(edges_query, {"cid": contract_id, "clause_ids": clause_ids})

    nodes: List[GraphNode] = []
    for n in raw_nodes:
        props = dict(n.get("properties") or {})
        # Trim noisy fields
        for k in ("text", "heading"):
            if k in props and isinstance(props[k], str) and len(props[k]) > 280:
                props[k] = props[k][:280] + "..."
        nodes.append(GraphNode(id=str(n["id"]), label=str(n["label"]), properties=props))
    edges: List[GraphEdge] = [
        GraphEdge(source=str(e["source"]), target=str(e["target"]), type=str(e["type"]))
        for e in raw_edges
    ]
    return GraphSnapshot(contract_id=contract_id, nodes=nodes, edges=edges)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# High-level writer
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def write_analysis(analysis: AnalysisResult) -> bool:
    """Persist an entire analysis result. Returns True if everything succeeded."""
    contract = analysis.contract
    success = True
    success &= upsert_contract(contract)
    for party in contract.parties:
        success &= upsert_party(contract.contract_id, party)
    for clause in analysis.clauses:
        success &= upsert_clause(contract.contract_id, clause)
    for obligation in analysis.obligations:
        success &= upsert_obligation(contract.contract_id, obligation)
    for risk in analysis.risks:
        success &= upsert_risk(contract.contract_id, risk)
    logger.info("Graph write for {}: {}", contract.contract_id, "ok" if success else "partial failure")
    return success

    MSA = "MSA"

    SPA = "SPA"
    EMPLOYMENT = "Employment"

    SERVICE = "Service"
    OTHER = "Other"


class PartySide(str, Enum):
    PROVIDER = "Provider"
    CUSTOMER = "Customer"
    EMPLOYER = "Employer"
    EMPLOYEE = "Employee"
    VENDOR = "Vendor"
    BUYER = "Buyer"
    SELLER = "Seller"
    NEUTRAL = "Neutral"


class RiskSeverity(str, Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    CRITICAL = "critical"


class ObligationType(str, Enum):
    OBLIGATION = "obligation"
    RIGHT = "right"
    PROHIBITION = "prohibition"
    CONDITION = "condition"


class JobStatus(str, Enum):
    QUEUED = "queued"
    RUNNING = "running"
    SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
    FAILED = "failed"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Domain models
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class Entity(BaseModel):
    text: str
    label: str
    start_char: Optional[int] = None
    end_char: Optional[int] = None
    confidence: float = 1.0
    source: str = "regex"  # 'ner' | 'regex' | 'rule'


class Clause(BaseModel):
    clause_id: str
    section_number: Optional[str] = None
    heading: Optional[str] = None
    text: str
    page_hint: Optional[int] = None
    char_start: int = 0
    char_end: int = 0
    clause_types: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    risk_score: float = 0.0
    risk_level: RiskSeverity = RiskSeverity.LOW
    risk_reasons: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

class Obligation(BaseModel):
    obligation_id: str

    counterparty: Optional[str] = None
    action: Optional[str] = None
    object: Optional[str] = None
    condition: Optional[str] = None
    deadline_expression: Optional[str] = None
    deadline_date: Optional[str] = None
    risk_level: RiskSeverity = RiskSeverity.LOW
    confidence: float = 0.7
    source: str = "rule"


class RiskFlag(BaseModel):
    risk_id: str
    clause_id: Optional[str] = None
    rule_id: str
    name: str
    severity: RiskSeverity
    explanation: str
    recommendation: Optional[str] = None
    score: float = 0.0


class ContractSummary(BaseModel):
    contract_id: str
    title: str
    file_name: str
    contract_type: ContractType = ContractType.OTHER
    jurisdiction: str = "India"
    parties: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    effective_date: Optional[str] = None
    expiry_date: Optional[str] = None
    governing_law: Optional[str] = None
    arbitration_seat: Optional[str] = None
    stamp_duty_mentioned: bool = False
    tds_mentioned: bool = False
    gstin_mentioned: bool = False
    overall_risk_score: float = 0.0
    overall_risk_level: RiskSeverity = RiskSeverity.LOW
    high_risk_clauses: int = 0
    missing_clauses: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    top_risks: List[RiskFlag] = Field(default_factory=list)
    clause_count: int = 0
    obligation_count: int = 0
    analyzed_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)


class AnalysisResult(BaseModel):
    contract: ContractSummary
    clauses: List[Clause] = Field(default_factory=list)
    obligations: List[Obligation] = Field(default_factory=list)
    risks: List[RiskFlag] = Field(default_factory=list)

class JobInfo(BaseModel):

class ContractMetadata(BaseModel):

"""Filesystem helpers for upload management."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import re
import shutil
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Tuple

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.exceptions import DocumentParseError

_SAFE_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+")


def safe_filename(name: str) -> str:
    """Sanitise a filename while preserving extension."""
    name = name.strip().replace(" ", "_")
    name = _SAFE_NAME_RE.sub("_", name)
    return name[:200] or "file"


def save_upload(file_bytes: bytes, original_name: str) -> Tuple[Path, str]:
    """Save uploaded bytes to disk and return (path, contract_id).

    contract_id is derived from a hash of the content + a timestamp, ensuring
    uniqueness even when the same file is uploaded multiple times in the same
    second.
    """
    settings = get_settings()
    upload_dir = Path(settings.upload_dir)
    upload_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    digest = hashlib.sha256(file_bytes).hexdigest()[:12]
    timestamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    contract_id = f"c_{timestamp}_{digest}"

    sanitised = safe_filename(original_name)
    target = upload_dir / f"{contract_id}_{sanitised}"
    try:
        target.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    except OSError as exc:
        raise DocumentParseError(f"Failed to persist upload: {exc}") from exc
    return target, contract_id


def derive_title_from_filename(filename: str) -> str:
    """Make a human-friendly title from an uploaded filename."""
    stem = Path(filename).stem
    stem = stem.replace("_", " ").replace("-", " ").strip()
    return stem.title() if stem else "Untitled Contract"


def remove_path_safely(path: str | Path) -> None:
    """Remove a file/directory, ignoring missing-path errors."""
    try:
        p = Path(path)
        if p.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
        elif p.exists():
            p.unlink()
    except OSError:
        # We deliberately swallow errors during cleanup.
        pass


def unique_id(prefix: str = "id") -> str:
    """Return a short unique identifier with a prefix."""
    return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}"

"""Text cleaning and normalisation utilities used across the pipeline."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unicodedata
from typing import List

# Whitespace normalisation regexes
_WS_RE = re.compile(r"[ \t\f\v]+")
_NL_RE = re.compile(r"\n{3,}")
_CONTROL_RE = re.compile(r"[\x00-\x08\x0b-\x1f\x7f]")

# Smart quote mapping (preserve readability while keeping tokens stable)
_SMART_QUOTE_MAP = str.maketrans({
    "\u2018": "'", "\u2019": "'",
    "\u201c": '"', "\u201d": '"',
    "\u2013": "-", "\u2014": "-",
    "\u2026": "...",
})

# Common Indian legal abbreviations and their expansions (used in token-pass hint).
INDIAN_LEGAL_TERMS = {
    "MSA": "Master Services Agreement",
    "NDA": "Non-Disclosure Agreement",
    "SPA": "Share Purchase Agreement",
    "SHA": "Shareholders Agreement",
    "CIN": "Corporate Identity Number",
    "PAN": "Permanent Account Number",
    "GSTIN": "Goods and Services Tax Identification Number",
    "TDS": "Tax Deducted at Source",
    "FY": "Financial Year",
    "INR": "Indian Rupee",
}


def normalise_whitespace(text: str) -> str:
    """Collapse runs of whitespace and trim each line, while preserving
    paragraph breaks (consecutive blank lines)."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
    text = _CONTROL_RE.sub("", text)
    cleaned_lines: list[str] = []
    blanks = 0
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        normalised = _WS_RE.sub(" ", line).strip()
        if not normalised:
            blanks += 1
            continue
        if blanks > 0 and cleaned_lines:
            # separator — keep as a single blank line between paragraphs.
            cleaned_lines.append("")
        cleaned_lines.append(normalised)
        blanks = 0
    return _NL_RE.sub("\n\n", "\n".join(cleaned_lines)).strip()


def normalise_unicode(text: str) -> str:
    """Normalise smart quotes, dashes, ellipsis to ASCII equivalents."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text)
    return text.translate(_SMART_QUOTE_MAP)


def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Full cleaning pipeline: unicode -> whitespace."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    return normalise_whitespace(normalise_unicode(text))


_SECTION_HEADING_RE = re.compile(
    r"""^(?P<num>
        (?:\d+(?:\.\d+)*)            # 1, 1.1, 1.1.1
        |(?:[A-Z]\.)                 # A.
        |(?:\([a-z0-9]+\))           # (a), (1)
        |(?:Article\s+\d+)           # Article 5
    )[\.\):]?\s+(?P<heading>.+)$""",
    re.VERBOSE,
)


def looks_like_section_heading(line: str) -> bool:
    """Heuristic check: does this line look like a clause heading?"""
    if not line:
        return False
    if len(line) > 180:
        return False
    return bool(_SECTION_HEADING_RE.match(line.strip()))


def detect_section_number(line: str) -> str | None:
    """Extract the section number if present, else None."""
    if not line:
        return None
    match = _SECTION_HEADING_RE.match(line.strip())
    return match.group("num") if match else None


def split_into_paragraphs(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split cleaned text into non-empty paragraphs."""
    if not text:
        return []
    return [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", text) if p.strip()]
